description: Plan an optional keyless task without contacting a provider. Send requestJson containing only task (web_search, read_page, pdf_parse or browser_screenshot), input (public search text or URL), optional provider (auto, exa, tavily, jina-ai, firecrawl or browserless), optional web_search sourceUrls (1–3 exact HTTPS result URLs; Tavily only; Exa/auto stop without switching), and required maxSpendUsd:0. This is returned-result URL filtering, not content verification or exhaustive source-only search. Inspect the returned access status, provider, sharing notice and approved reading scope before execution. Does not inspect accounts saved in your agent host. Browserless requires a host-managed account and cannot run through ToolSkipper. No payment authorization is accepted.

requestJson.description: Complete JSON request: {"task":"web_search","input":"public research query","provider":"auto","maxSpendUsd":0}. Optional sourceUrls is web_search-only: 1–3 distinct canonical public HTTPS URLs, without query, fragment, credentials, port or encoded characters. Only Tavily supports this local filter on structured returned result URLs; Exa/auto is unavailable when sourceUrls is supplied. This is not native search restriction, complete source coverage or content verification. Supported tasks: web_search (auto/Exa or tavily), read_page (auto/Jina, firecrawl or file2markdown), pdf_parse (firecrawl only, fixed public W3C one-page sample), browser_screenshot (browserless setup only). Provider switches require an explicit new request; no automatic fallback. No credentials or private input. read_page is limited to approved public documentation URLs without query strings. browser_screenshot returns host connection requirements and does not run.
